objective: Replace the pending journal-based migration with direct provider-scoped key updates/deletes and explicit backup-only recovery, leaving UI/backend changes untouched.

ownership.rfcs/0016-eos-canonical-parameters/jsons: coordinator; independent challenger/reviewer own their receipts

principles.kiss: One transaction, direct UPDATE and DELETE, no journal or temporary tables.
principles.yagni: Remove automatic rollback infrastructure and SQL numeric parsing.
principles.single_source_of_truth: Existing canonical keys win; absent defaults remain runtime-owned.
principles.contracts: Preserve key precedence, exact value text, IDs and audit fields. Down explicitly refuses lossy restoration.
principles.fail_safe: Bounded locks and transaction rollback protect failed operations; value auditing is an operator preflight prerequisite.
principles.security: Exact EOS provider and input scope, count-only diagnostics, no live database access.
principles.observability: Disposable test snapshots supply changed/deleted counts without production recovery state.
principles.reversibility: User accepts pre-migration backup restoration instead of automatic down migration. Preserve original design evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Only the selected aliases are renamed; lower-priority/obsolete keys are removed.
All stored value text remains unchanged, including zero, custom models, numeric separators and malformed values; no implicit fallback or reset occurs.
Inactive inputs are included; output, missing/unknown providers, silence EOS, backend paths and unrelated fields remain untouched.
No journal or temporary tables and no application option inserts.
Repeat up is a no-op; SQL errors and write contention abort atomically; down fails without changing configuration.
The old implementation has not reached a live database; no compatibility with its journal is added.
UI/backend changes and existing unrelated full-history blocker are not altered.
risks: Backup restoration is mandatory for recovery after successful deletion.
Operators must audit selected values before rollout; migration intentionally does not validate numeric content.
Writers must remain stopped across backup, audit, migration and deployment.

open_blockers: Independent amendment challenge and exact-digest gate pending
